in_sanskrit.name: ललिता
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is adorned with lotus, the one who is beautiful, graceful and elegant.

in_hindi.name: ललिता
in_hindi.long_meaning: जिसका सर लोतुस है, वह सुनदन, सुकरण है।

in_telugu.name: లలిథ్యా
in_telugu.long_meaning: హలీదయిళ్లో ఆశేశ, హల్లీయిళ్లో శౌయేయోశ్ణ, వీజనముయే దేశీ.

in_marathi.name: Lalithya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lalithya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lalithya is the goddess of beauty, grace, and fertility in Hindu mythology. She is known as the consort of Lord Vishnu and is often depicted with lotus flowers. The name Lalithya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'lalita', which means 'playful' or 'graceful'.
